sourceTitle: Flatbread making and sharing culture: Lavash, Katyrma, Jupka, Yufka — UNESCO Representative List
copyrightNotes: Yalnız kısa olgu ifadeleri alındı; pasaj kopyalanmadı, tanımlar yeniden ifade edildi.
exactSourceStatements: Inscribed in 2016 (11.COM) on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity
It is baked using a tandyr/tanur (an earth or stone oven in the ground), saj (a metal plate) or kazan (a cauldron).
Besides regular meals, flatbread is shared at weddings, births, funerals, various holidays and during prayers.
